scientific_review: Seven independently documented EAC mooring locations near27S were prescribed before velocity retrieval, for2022-01-15 and2022-07-15. All14 profiles retained;13 contain some unfilled meridional velocity. The July NRSNSI profile remains missing rather than being replaced by a convenient date, station or filled product.

Only daily unfilled UCUR/VCUR and their source uncertainty fields were retrieved,8768 scalar values total after coordinate/budget checks. These are processed observations with vertical/time linear gridding and a5-day filter, not raw instrument samples or instantaneous model fields. No SOM-filled velocity or spatially mapped no-slip boundary is used.

Poleward component is negative true-north VCUR. Five lower5cm/s, five lower10cm/s and six lower20cm/s crossings resolve across dated station profiles. Their shared profiles and threshold sensitivities are not independent observations, annual extrema, complete physical current bottoms or depth confidence bounds.

Most upper boundaries remain censored because the source lacks surface velocity support. The resolved5cm/s and10cm/s thickness spans occur at far-offshore EAC4800 on January15 and belong only to those local connected velocity components. They are not promoted to main-jet thickness or a physical EAC volume.

EAC3200 dated lower5cm/s crossings are940m in January and1066.6666666666667m in July; EAC4200 values are1068m and992.5m. Native brackets, upper censoring, fixed coordinates, full component profiles and source uncertainty arrays remain retained. These four values illustrate regional profile support, not along-route or seasonal extrema.

Nearest existing27S HYCOM sample-node index, position and geodesic separation are reported only for spatial audit. The observational array is oblique near27S while the editorial model section is at27S. No coincident-section, same temporal filter, model-error estimate or named-current-axis validation is claimed from proximity.

All19 cloud checks passed: twelve frozen connected-layer checks and seven exact-date, duplicate-date, pre-read budget, sign, missing-surface, missing-deep and opposing-flow acquisition checks. Processing was sequential on one idle cloud CPU. Local operations retained cloud bytes and verified input pins only.

Provider source attributes, time indices, actual UTC daily labels, units, sea-surface positive-down datum and CC BY4.0 attribution remain in the artifact. No wire-byte hash or full original-source checksum is claimed for OPeNDAP subsets. Uncertainty arrays do not by themselves establish an error distribution or propagated boundary confidence interval.

The benchmark changes no canonical depth register, reference-route geometry, runtime/UI or eddy size record. Canonical depth coverage remains439 scoped references across101 identities. No whole-route physical depth profile or whole-current water volume is admitted.
next_actions: Admit source-qualified fixed-station lower-contour descriptors separately from whole-current physical depth and unresolved upper boundaries.
Use independently bounded observational/satellite axis information or a source-backed regional branch operator before treating an editorial model route as a tracked EAC jet.
Retain source temporal filtering and spatial separation when evaluating model/observation compatibility; do not turn two dates into seasonal extrema.
